title: Folding Patterns
summary: A browser tool that generates accordion, pleated and Kresling folding patterns and previews them in 3D. A lampshade version exports the flat pattern as a 1:1 PDF ready to print and cut.

title: Seen Through
title_zh: 透明公廁的環境知覺調查
summary: A phone-based study of Shigeru Ban's transparent public toilet in Haru-no-Ogawa Community Park, Tokyo. Participants choose a booth and use it under four visual boundaries, from a solid wall to frosted glass, glass that frosts when locked, and glass that stays clear, while people walk past outside. They rate privacy and safety and mark where their private space begins, asking whether opaque really means safe. Answers go straight to Google Sheets.
